stem: A square floor tile has area $64$ cm$^{2}$. Ritu needs the side length of the tile.

options.text: The side length produces the perfect square, so the side length is $64$ cm.
The side length is $8$ cm, the positive square root of $64$.
A side length of $-8$ cm is allowed for this tile.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: If the area is $64$, the side length is the positive square root $8$ cm. A physical length cannot be negative.

teacher.key_rationale: Side length is the positive square root of the area. Setting the side equal to the area reverses the square relation. A negative root is outside the physical side-length scope.
